description:
Make the cargo-ci load classifier judge the host's load before this run starts, so the steward's quiet-host rule and the classifier agree.

## Background

494f1d4b made `scripts/cargo-ci.sh` exit 75 for environment-sensitive failures (test TIMEOUTs without FAIL, a suite-duration overrun) on a loaded host. It samples the 1-minute load average just before and after the suite clock and calls the host loaded at 1.25 × nproc. That sample follows the run's own fmt, clippy and build fan-out, so it measures the run itself, and 30 on 24 CPUs is almost never reached: runs at load1 12.7 and 17.1 that timed out on known fixture contention were recorded as content verdicts. The milestone steward calls a host quiet at roughly load below 4 on 24 cores and approved this task.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: The classifier judges the 1-minute load average sampled before the run's first step against 0.17 × nproc, and the printed classification line names that baseline sample, the threshold and the resulting classification.
- [hard] REQ-02: The script's self-test covers a baseline on each side of the threshold.
title: Classify cargo-ci load from a pre-run baseline
